create_RealDataSampler: create a RealDataSampler instance with train data, test sampler, and tau batch size
build_make_local_sampler: build a local sampler that samples from kappa anchor points with replacement
build_make_global_sampler: build a global sampler that uniformly samples data points with replacement
test_RealDataSampler_test_data: test the RealDataSampler test_data method to return test data and zero log-likelihood
review_RealDataSampler_train_data: review the RealDataSampler train_data property that returns the stored training data
